items.title: How MoEngage built agentic customer engagement on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: MoEngage built Merlin AI, a set of AI agents on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that let marketing and product teams draft, analyze, and adjust campaigns from a single conversation. Learn how MoEngage turned its existing APIs into MCP tools and kept each tenant's data isolated while giving agents secure access to live platform data.
items.creator: Ashwin Srinivasan
